name: gate-driver-core-drive-with-uvlo-postlayout
description: Post-layout re-run of gate-driver-core-drive-with-uvlo (issue #220's schematic-level facet), against the #221-extended, DRC-clean/LVS-matched layout/gate_driver_core.gds (issue #222, epic #219/#542 Phase 3A slice 3): same end-to-end stimulus chain -- logic-in (IN) -> level_shifter -> output_stage -> 1 nF reference load -- PLUS x3=uvlo actively pulling OUT low whenever VDD_DRV sits below that corner's trip point, now driven against the extracted device geometry (layout/lvs/gate_driver_core.extracted.spice, --combine, no interconnect parasitics) or the RC-parasitic extraction (layout/lvs/gate_driver_core.extracted-rc.spice, klt extract --parasitics, run via --dut) rather than the ideal schematic. Substantiates the same claims as the schematic-level facet, plus the extraction-only RC delta on the same metrics -- particularly UVLO lockout response, per issue #222's own callout.
claim: spec/gate-driver.md#3-drive-strength-and-reference-load; spec/gate-driver.md#23-dc-gate-voltage-ceiling-thin-oxide-vs-thick-oxide; spec/gate-driver.md#5-protection-scope-uvlo; spec/decision-records/0001-block-interface-and-uvlo-parameters.md Decision 5 (OUT forced low during lockout, independent of IN)
analyses: meas tran trise10_90 TRIG v(OUT) VAL=outlo RISE=1 TARG v(OUT) VAL=outhi RISE=1
meas tran tfall10_90 TRIG v(OUT) VAL=outhi FALL=1 TARG v(OUT) VAL=outlo FALL=1
meas tran tpdlh TRIG v(IN) VAL=inmid RISE=1 TARG v(OUT) VAL=outmid RISE=1
meas tran tpdhl TRIG v(IN) VAL=inmid FALL=1 TARG v(OUT) VAL=outmid FALL=1
meas tran lockout_at_in_high FIND v(x3_lockout) AT=200n
meas tran vout_at_in_high FIND v(OUT) AT=200n
meas tran vdrv_at_in_high FIND v(VDD_DRV) AT=200n

trise_s.description: spec Sec.3: 10-90% rise into 1nF reference load < 50ns, end-to-end IN->OUT (no stretch target). Only meaningful at points where UVLO is released (OUT actually switches) -- at a locked corner this measurement's crossing never fires and the point is recorded as failed/missing per sim/README.md's honest-recording convention, not silently scored as a pass; see the record narrative for which corners that is.

tfall_s.description: spec Sec.3: 10-90% fall into 1nF reference load < 50ns, end-to-end IN->OUT (no stretch target). Same UVLO-released caveat as trise_s.

tpdlh_s.description: spec Sec.3: low-to-high propagation delay < 50ns nominal, < 25ns at the 6V vdrv stretch corner, end-to-end IN->OUT. Same UVLO-released caveat as trise_s.

tpdhl_s.description: spec Sec.3: high-to-low propagation delay < 50ns nominal, < 25ns at the 6V vdrv stretch corner, end-to-end IN->OUT. Same UVLO-released caveat as trise_s.

ipeak_source_a.description: spec Sec.3: peak source current into 1nF load >= 0.5A nominal, >= 1A at the 6V vdrv stretch corner. Same UVLO-released caveat as trise_s -- a locked corner sources no peak current by design.

ipeak_sink_a.description: spec Sec.3: peak sink current into 1nF load >= 0.5A nominal, >= 1A at the 6V vdrv stretch corner. Same UVLO-released caveat as trise_s. NOTE: decision record 0016 documents a pre-existing, bounded exception at the ss_125c/sf_125c 6V-stretch corners (>= 0.85A) -- confirmed unaffected by the layout/extraction this facet re-runs against, see this facet's own record narrative.

vout_max_v.description: sanity: OUT must not exceed the swept drive rail plus headroom (no uncontrolled overshoot source in this chain)

vout_min_v.description: sanity: OUT must not undershoot below GND_DRV -- the same inherited -50mV band as indrv_min_v below

indrv_max_v.description: spec Sec.2.3 gate-ceiling evidence: IN_DRV must not exceed the swept rail plus headroom -- carried over unchanged from sim/gate-driver-core-drive-postlayout/

indrv_min_v.description: sanity: IN_DRV must not undershoot GND_DRV -- the -50mV band is NOT a spec value, carried over unchanged from sim/gate-driver-core-drive-postlayout/ (CLAUDE.md: agents do not relax a bound to make results pass)

n1_max_v.description: spec Sec.2.3 gate-ceiling evidence: output-stage taper node n1 under real level-shifter drive

n1_min_v.description: sanity: taper node n1 must not undershoot GND_DRV -- same inherited -50mV band. NOTE: this bound is known exceeded at several corners even at the schematic level (sim/gate-driver-core-drive/, sim/gate-driver-core-drive-with-uvlo/) -- pre-existing, not introduced by layout/extraction; see this facet's own record narrative for the schematic-vs-postlayout comparison.

uvlo_lockout_at_in_high.description: x3_lockout sampled at t=200ns (mid-way through IN's first high pulse, decision record 0001 Decision 5 evidence): a robust FIND-based measurement (not crossing-based, so it never goes missing) recording whether UVLO was asserting lockout (high) or released (low) at this PVT point, independent of whether OUT actually switched. Not scored (informational -- see record narrative for the honest per-corner disposition against the schematic facet's own result at the same corner).

uvlo_vout_at_in_high_v.description: OUT sampled at t=200ns, same IN-high window as uvlo_lockout_at_in_high. Decision record 0001 Decision 5's core claim: OUT is forced low here whenever uvlo_lockout_at_in_high is asserted, independent of IN=high. Range check only (sanity); see record narrative for the paired lockout/OUT correlation.

uvlo_vdrv_at_in_high_v.description: VDD_DRV sampled at t=200ns -- records this PVT point's actual drive-rail bias for direct comparison against the schematic facet's own uvlo_vdrv_at_in_high_v at the same (process, temperature) corner. Range check only (sanity).
